items.text: For a rework round, scripts/brief gives the new builder the node, round and matching previous review file. The first round needs no earlier review. Exercise the brief size budget and review selection with scripts/brief-test.

Fail one round, resume, and verify that a new builder gets the next brief with the last review and the remaining round budget. Fallback coordinator instructions also start a fresh session. Run scripts/run-plan-test and scripts/brief-test.
